# JSContact Card 2.0 core

This contract provides a deliberately bounded JSContact Card representation
for interoperable contact records. It follows JSContact 2.0, including the
optional `uid` introduced by RFC 9982.

The profile accepts a strict subset of JSContact properties. It is not an
official IETF JSON Schema and does not claim to validate every JSContact
extension or conditional semantic rule.

---
kind: mdbase.type
name: jscontact-card
version: 1
description: A Markdown-backed JSContact 2.0 core Card
match:
  where:
    /@type: Card
    version: "2.0"
schema:
  dialect: json-schema-2020-12
  ref: ../schemas/mdbase.jscontact.card/2.0.0.schema.json
collection:
  display:
    name_field: /name/full
implements:
  - contract: mdbase.jscontact.card
    version: 2.0.0
    fields:
      /@type: /@type
      version: version
      uid: uid
      kind: kind
      name: name
      emails: emails
      phones: phones
      organizations: organizations
      notes: notes
---

# JSContact Card

This starter type stores the strict core profile directly in Markdown
frontmatter. Records identify themselves with:

```yaml
"@type": Card
version: "2.0"
```

The Markdown body remains available for unstructured context that is not part
of the portable JSContact view.
